title: vs/v1/dev/{id}/config (retained, hive -> hornet). Sections a role does not use are omitted

sleep_s.description: Battery hornets: deep sleep this long between readings (wake, send, sleep). 0 or absent: always awake. While asleep the hornet keeps its last status; the hive treats it as lost after several missed wake-ups

sleep_mode.description: How a hornet with sleep_s > 0 saves power. deep (default): radio and CPU off between readings, disconnects; needs GPIO16 wired to RST on ESP8266. light: stays connected with Wi-Fi power saving and reads every sleep_s; works on any board, saves far less

features.description: What the hornet is used for (roles meteo, relay, heat). thermometer: a temperature sensor, DS18B20s on 1-Wire or a DHT11/DHT22 (hw.thermometer); bme280: BME280 on I2C; relay: a relay switched by commands; heater: that relay heats and the hornet itself keeps failsafe.heater (needs relay and a sensor). Pins of features not listed are left alone. Absent: the role's default (meteo: thermometer, bme280; relay: relay; heat: thermometer, relay, heater)

hw.description: Board wiring; omitted fields keep the firmware defaults for the board

dht_pin.description: DHT11/DHT22 data pin, used when thermometer is dht11 or dht22

ir_pin.description: Roles irrx and irtx: the pin of the infrared receiver or emitter (GPIO2 on the ESP-01 with the WS2812 connector)

vbat_pin.description: ADC pin with a voltage divider from the battery (roles meteo and relay; ESP8266 always reads A0 = 17)

vbat_ratio.description: Divider ratio (R1+R2)/R2, e.g. 5.7 for 47k/10k: battery V = pin V x ratio

thermometer.description: Which sensor the feature thermometer reads (roles meteo and heat). ds18b20: one or more on 1-Wire (onewire_pin); dht11 or dht22: one DHT on dht_pin, which also gives humidity. Absent: the board's (dht11 on the esp-01-dht11 module, ds18b20 elsewhere)

max_on_s.description: 0 = no limit; the relay switches off by itself after this

display.description: Screen of a hornet or a monitor: what the hive feeds it (items, vs/v1/hive/display/{id}); lines: up to two of its own metrics on the old meteo-c3oled build

rotation.description: Screens the hive draws (e-ink): how the picture is turned, clockwise. Items, x, y and the background image are laid out in the turned screen (a panel standing on its side is 90 or 270); the hive turns the finished picture back for the panel. Absent: the board's default (0; 270 for crowpanel-epd37, which stands landscape)

invert.description: Screens the hive draws (e-ink): black and white swapped on every tab, white on black (a dark screen). Absent: false

monitor.description: Monitoring of a monitor far away (contracts/monitor-http.md, X-Frame-Refresh): until the time is up it reads its screen every every_min minutes, then at its own interval. Kept by the hive; set on the monitor's page

items.description: What the screen shows, kept by the hive: a reading of this hornet or of another device. Up to 4 in the automatic layout, up to 8 when placed (size set). The hornet does not read it: the hive turns it into the display message

text.description: A caption the person typed instead of a reading: shown as it is, without a source (then device and metric are absent)

x.description: Placed layout: pixels from the left edge to the anchor of the text (align says which edge of the text). Absent: 0

y.description: Placed layout: pixels from the top edge to the top of the text (of the label when there is one). Absent: 0

size.description: Relative text height: size/10 of the screen height, at least 6 px; the screen takes its largest font not taller than that. Set on any item: the whole screen is placed by x, y, size

align.description: Placed layout: which edge of the text x is. Absent: left

font.description: Screens the hive draws (e-ink): the id of the font family (GET /api/display/fonts). Absent: the standard font. The panel only shows the picture; the small OLED ignores it

px.description: Screens the hive draws: the size of the font in pixels (the UI offers the sizes the family reads well at: GET /api/display/fonts, sizes). Absent: derived from size. Ignored by the small OLED

bold.description: Screens the hive draws: bold (a family without a bold face is emboldened)

italic.description: Screens the hive draws: italic (a family without an italic face is slanted)

clock.description: The hive's clock instead of a reading (then device, metric and text are absent): the time or the date in the hive's time zone, as format says

format.description: How the clock is written (Russian names): time HH:mm (absent) or H:mm; date d MMMM (absent: 28 октября), d MMM (28 окт), dd.MM, dd.MM.yyyy, dd/MM, dddd (среда), ddd, d MMM (ср, 28 окт), d MMMM yyyy, MMMM (октябрь)

ir.description: Roles irrx and irtx: the remote's buttons learned and named by the family. The hive keeps them and sends the code with each cmd/ir; the hornet does not read them

ble.description: Role ble: the Bluetooth LE thermometer the hornet is a bridge for (Inkbird IHT-2PB)

mac.description: Bluetooth address of the thermometer; without it the hornet scans and lists what it hears in its log

dump.description: Put the raw notification frames in the hornet's log (to check the decoding against the thermometer's own app)
